home.layout: Sticky tabbed search nav over a teal hero with location search, followed by stacked sections: featured suburbs grid, weekend auction results table, news cards row, and app download CTA banner.

search.layout: Left filter sidebar (260px) with collapsible groups, right main area with results count, sort dropdown, grid/list/map toggle, and a 3-column property card grid with pagination.

listing.layout: Full-width photo gallery carousel up top, two-column body with main details (price, address, beds/baths/cars, description, floorplan) on left and sticky agent contact card plus inspection times on right, suburb profile widget below.

suburb.layout: Suburb hero with median price stats row, two-column area with trend chart and demographics panel, full-width recent sales table, schools map, and a for-sale listings grid at the bottom.

agents.layout: Top filter bar for suburb and agency, three-column grid of agent cards with photo, sales stats and agency logo, side panel for top agents leaderboard and request appraisal CTA.
